args.body:
Summary of websites shared in #general:

• www.informations.com — A job report showing mixed signals: unemployment edged down to 7.2%, bringing both relief and concern.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant, a cozy alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city serving authentic Swiss cuisine (cheese fondue, rösti, chocolate fondue), with warm wood interiors, Swiss memorabilia, panoramic city views, and friendly staff in traditional attire.

Hi Dora! I visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean introduction to you and your personal site — easy to read and it gives visitors a quick sense of who you are. One suggestion: adding a bit more content (a short bio, some of your interests or work, and maybe links to your other profiles) would make it feel more complete and engaging. Great start though!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com). I like that it clearly centers on your passion for hiking — it gives the blog a warm, personal identity. To make it even more compelling, consider adding some actual blog posts or photos from your hikes, plus details like favorite trails or gear recommendations. That would turn a simple intro page into a place readers want to return to. Keep it up!
